#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "include/gemmini_testutils.h"

// AUTO-GENERATED optimized MX matmul kernel (128x128x256, fp6:e3m2).
void solution(void) {
  {
    int ti = MATMUL_M / DIM / 2, tj = MATMUL_N / DIM / 2, tk = MATMUL_K / DIM;
    uint32_t ab = 0;
    uint32_t bb = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tk * tj * DIM;
    
    // Split ti into 2 blocks of 2 to trigger Accumulator Double-Buffering
    int block_ti = 2;
    
    gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 1, 1, 3, 1);
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&A_scales_row, sizeof(A_scales_row), 0);
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)&B_scales_col, sizeof(B_scales_col), 1);
    gemmini_config_st(OUT_COLS * sizeof(out_t));
    gemmini_mx_load_lut((uint64_t)B_lut_p, 1, 0);
    gemmini_mx_load_lut((uint64_t)A_lut_p, 1, 1);
    
    // Batch MVIN for A: Load all A tiles at once (2 tiles batched)
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t));
    for (int i = 0; i < ti; i++) {
      for (int k = 0; k < tk; k += 2) {
        gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in_hw) + i*DIM*MATMUL_K + k*DIM), ab + (i*tk + k)*DIM, 2 * DIM, DIM);
      }
    }
    
    // Batch MVIN for B: Load all B tiles at once (2 tiles batched)
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t));
    for (int k = 0; k < tk; k++) {
      for (int j = 0; j < tj; j += 2) {
        gemmini_extended_mvin2((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + k*DIM*MATMUL_N + j*DIM), bb + (j*tk + k)*DIM, 2 * DIM, DIM);
      }
    }
    
    // Configure output for first block
    gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, block_ti, tj, tk, 0, 1, tk);
    
    // Block 0: First 2 tiles of I 
    gemmini_loop_ws_spad(block_ti, tj, tk, 0, 0, 0, ab, bb, 0, 0, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);
    
    // Configure output for second block  
    gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)((uint8_t*)scale_factors + block_ti * tk * sizeof(uint8_t)), block_ti, tj, tk, 0, 1, tk);
    
    // Block 1: Second 2 tiles of I
    gemmini_loop_ws_spad(block_ti, tj, tk, 0, 0, 0, ab + block_ti * tk * DIM, bb, 0, 128, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);
    
    // Read results from shared memory
    gemmini_mx_read_smem(&C_hw[0][0], 0 * 16, 64 * MATMUL_N);
    gemmini_mx_read_smem((uint16_t*)&C_hw[64][0], 128 * 16, 64 * MATMUL_N);
    
    gemmini_fence();
  }
}
